_comment: Verified affiliate products. Every ASIN here was resolved from the owner's
own SiteStripe short link on 2026-08-19 and its title checked against the
live listing — never transcribe an ASIN from memory or a search result, and
never invent one: a wrong ASIN links silently to the wrong product.
`dest` is the bare ASIN. gen/affiliate.mjs builds a clean
amazon.com/dp/<ASIN>?tag=... from it, deliberately dropping SiteStripe's
search cruft (crid/dib/qid/sr/ref_) — those are search-session artifacts,
some are timestamps, and Amazon's agreement is against search-result links.
NO PRICES anywhere near these. Amazon restricts quoting prices outside its
API and prices move; the copy describes the product, never what it costs.

controller-ps5.label: PlayStation DualSense controller
controller-ps5.note: Midnight Black. Owner picked black over Sterling Silver 2026-08-19 — same product, two colours, linking both only splits clicks.

thumb-grips.label: KontrolFreek thumbstick grips
thumb-grips.note: FPS Freek Galaxy, PS4/PS5. Owner kept it 2026-08-19 after being shown the 'FPS' branding reads slightly off in a football article.

fc27-ps5.label: EA SPORTS FC 27 — PlayStation 5 disc
fc27-ps5.note: PERMANENT on Amazon: CDKeys and Fanatical sell keys only, so a disc buyer has no other route. Pre-order converts at click time, which sidesteps the 24h cookie.

fc27-xbox.label: EA SPORTS FC 27 — Xbox Series X disc
fc27-xbox.note: PERMANENT on Amazon, same reason as the PS5 disc.

fc27-pc.label: EA SPORTS FC 27 — PC (EA App) digital
fc27-pc.note: STOPGAP. Digital competes head-on with CDKeys/Fanatical at 3-8% against Amazon's ~1%. MOVE THIS to a key seller the day one of them approves. No disc edition exists for PC (owner, 2026-08-19).
